summary: In Part 34 of Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter), Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses the Islamic concept of divine decree (al-qaeda) as a pillar of faith. He explains why understanding decree is complex and often misunderstood among Muslims, tracing this confusion to the collapse of the centralized Muslim empire and the rise of unqualified teachers speaking on Islamic matters. The sheikh emphasizes that proper understanding of Islamic doctrine requires knowing it through the lens of how the Prophet Muhammad and his companions understood it, not arbitrary personal interpretations. He discusses how the separation of Muslim nations into different countries has fragmented Islamic knowledge and created unnecessary differences among Muslims.
